verdict_text:
NO

The plan omits `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` from the bfloat16 cast pattern, so only 36 of the 48 required projection matrices are cast, violating Required result clause 1 (and leaving the 12 `attn.c_proj.weight` tensors in float32). Correspondingly, the required check "exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16" is not implemented at all — the plan asserts a count of 36 matching names instead, so the run would not fail loudly on this error. Additionally, `shard: 64MB` is decimal 64,000,000 rather than the specified 64 MiB (67,108,864 bytes), which changes the shard boundaries the grader compares against.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
